neighbours.label: Scalar phrases 'a bit' and 'a lot' in informal evaluations.
fire: For a travel guide, I found it a bit vague.
The new restaurant seemed a bit noisy to me.
For an introductory lesson, the explanation was a bit confusing.
I thought the ending of the film was a bit rushed.
That seems like a lot of money for a used bicycle.
I thought that was a lot of effort for a minor repair.
Twenty pages sounds like a lot of paperwork for one permit.
To me, that feels like a lot of trouble for a short visit.
quiet: For a travel guide, I found it somewhat vague.
The new restaurant seemed somewhat noisy to me.
For an introductory lesson, the explanation was somewhat confusing.
I thought the ending of the film was somewhat rushed.
That seems like too much money for a used bicycle.
I thought that was too much effort for a minor repair.
Twenty pages sounds like too much paperwork for one permit.
To me, that feels like too much trouble for a short visit.
